tasks.title: The Moon
tasks.statement: You have 3 minutes to read the problem. Then accelerated animation of the Moon's motion will be shown twice during 4 minutes. Moreover at the 2nd time the animation will be paused at the beginning and at the end. After that you will have 2 minutes to write an answer. Find out the month of the observation.

parts.question: Find out the month of the observation.

tasks.title: Motion of the planets
tasks.statement: You have 2.5 minutes to read the problem. Then an accelerated animation of the Sun's and planets's motion relative to stars will be shown twice during 5 minutes. Moreover at the 2nd time the animation will be paused at the beginning and at the end. After that you will have 2 minutes to write the answers.

parts.question: Estimate dates (+/- 1 week) of the beginning and of the end of the animation.
Write, which constellations (their standard three-letter designation) the Mars and the Venus had passed.

tasks.title: Outline
tasks.statement: Недавно астрономы обнаружили новое рассеянное звёздное скопление. Максимальное время выполнения задания - 11 минут.

parts.question: Наведите телескоп на его копию. Зарисуйте конфигурацию «звёзд».
Один из астрономов узнал в очертаниях скопления знакомое созвездие. Напишите его стандартное трехбуквенное обозначение.
